title: Chamomile and Lavender Herbal Infusion with Lemon
summary: A caffeine-free, delicate infusion of dried chamomile and lavender flowers with bright lemon notes.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Mix 6 tbsp dried chamomile flowers and 2 tbsp dried culinary lavender in a jar to make about 8 tbsp blend.

steps.title: Brew
steps.text: Put 4 tbsp blend and 4 thin lemon slices in a glass teapot or its strainer.

steps.title: Steep
steps.text: Pour over 960 ml just-boiled water, cover so the aroma stays in, and steep 5 min (up to 7 for stronger brew; be careful as lavender turns soapy if overdone).

steps.title: Strain
steps.text: Strain into mugs and add a lemon slice to each.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Sweeten with honey if liked and serve hot.

tips: Keep the teapot covered while steeping to trap the fragrant oils and prevent over-steeping.
Lavender can turn soapy if steeped too long; 5 minutes is usually ideal.
safety: Those with ragweed allergies may react to chamomile, which is in the daisy family.
storage: The dried blend keeps airtight and away from light for up to one month. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
